preservedBoundaries: All 16 original full names remain independently registered: 5 Cerebras, 6 Fireworks, 5 Mistral. Tuple tables use %s with the original title as the first scalar argument.
All original endpoint URLs, provider/request model distinctions, history strings, max_tokens=1000, API key, CLI version/proxy defaults and prompt identifiers remain.

Exact hostname, accepted subdomain, hostile suffix and non-provider routing cases remain provider-local. Mistral custom URL/mixed-case model fallback and declared DeepSeek profile remain independent inputs.

Fireworks removes only the mirrored reasoning value while keeping reasoning_content; distinct Canonical reasoning field is independently preserved. Cerebras/Mistral stripping cannot mutate the original history.

The HTTP stand-in retains each original rejection predicate and error payload, exact success payload, ephemeral IPv4 loopback binding, endpoint path, explicit provider constructor and two real generator calls.

Expected assistants and wire user messages are handwritten test data. No provider or converter generates expected output. Only a pre-call structuredClone of the input supplies the unchanged surrounding-message/source-history oracle.
structuralChanges: The two one-case HTTP suites now acquire and close their server inside the case helper using try/finally instead of beforeAll/afterAll; setup and teardown therefore fall inside the case timeout.

Four ordinary route cases in each file use a tuple table with exact original scalar titles. The Fireworks distinct-reasoning case and Mistral declared-profile case remain separate it calls and run after their local routing table.

Two complete response checks plus exact first/follow-up wire messages replace five assertions in each HTTP case. Fourteen direct cases each use complete messages plus complete input nonmutation; expected total runtime assertion executions change from 29 to 34, pending execution.
